description: From any two of distance, time and pace: pace per km and per mile, speed (km/h, mph), 400 m lap, finish time, every km or mile split (even, negative or positive split plan), finish times of the classic races at this pace and Riegel race predictions. Distances as 10 km, 5 miles, 400 m, half marathon; pace also as 12 km/h or 7.5 mph. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pace-calculator.

distance.description: Distance, e.g. 10 km, 5 miles, 400 m, half marathon, marathon (not needed for find=distance)

find.description: What to calculate: pace, time or distance

pace.description: Pace or speed, e.g. 5:30, 8:51 /mi, 12 km/h, 7.5 mph (not needed for find=pace)

splitPlan.description: even, neg2 (second half 2% faster), neg5 or pos3

time.description: Time, e.g. 50:00, 1:45:00 or 3h 30m; a bare number is minutes (not needed for find=time)

unit.description: Unit for splits and for bare numbers: km or mi

name: pace_calculator
title: Pace Calculator API - running pace, finish time, splits and race predictions
